facts.fact: In 2021, approximately 57.5 million viewers in the US watched digital live sports content at least once per month, according to Statista as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: In 2021, approximately 57.5 million viewers in the US watched digital live sports content at least once per month

facts.fact: Statista projects that US monthly viewership of digital live sports content will rise to over 90 million by 2025, as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: a figure that is projected to rise to over [90 million by 2025]

facts.fact: Geotargeting lets advertisers target ads by country, state, US county, city, or zip code, or by a list of addresses or latitude and longitude coordinates.
facts.quote: You can target by country, state, US county, city, or zip code, or leverage a list of addresses or latitude and longitude coordinates

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes contextual advertising as a cookieless targeting tactic that places ads based on the page content rather than user behaviour.
